datasets.title: Gas and mass of El Gordo
datasets.description: NASA's 2014 Hubble release of El Gordo in its layers: Chandra's X-ray image of the hot gas in red and the mass map from gravitational lensing in blue. Each is drawn as a body round a published line: the gas about the axis Menanteau et al. (2012) took it apart on, the mass about the line through the two peaks of Jee et al. (2014). That depth is a symmetry the papers assume, not a measurement. The Hubble picture, with its stars and galaxies removed, stands flat at the cluster's distance.
datasets.summary: Red is X-ray gas and blue is the lensing mass map, each drawn round a published line. Their depth is not measured.

facts.label: Colors
